card.name: Spaces before years in dates
card.fires_on: The space or first digit right before a year (or day and year) in a date or citation, after a weekday, month or journal name. It is common in web page datelines and reference lists.

modes.label: Space before year
modes.description: The space after a weekday, comma or month, just before the day or year number.

modes.label: Digit starting a year
modes.description: The first digit of a year written in a date stamp.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of month and season names coming next, so a number such as the year is expected.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a date where a year or day number comes next, not a month name.
